_comment: Copy to setup/actions-config.json and make it yours (not in git). Private-only: drop the work account, keep "workplaces": []. Several employers/clients: one entry per workplace, each with its own mail account and/or domains.

owner.name: Alex Example
owner._logins: Tailscale logins that may add, edit and delete contacts and calendar events from the dashboard. Leave out: the first login on the access list.

mail_providers_comment: Optional. The scam check trusts a sender check that says "pass" only when one of these mail providers wrote it (its Authentication-Results above its own Received lines). Default: iCloud, Gmail and Outlook.

reply_debt._comment: Who you owe a reply (To do / Today): work after work_days working days, private after private_days days; older than max_days drops off.

meetings._comment: Meeting prep: recordings are transcribed on this Mac mini with whisper.cpp (tools/setup-whisper.sh installs it). All three are optional – without them Axella looks in the usual places (/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli, ~/.cache/whisper/ggml-*.bin).
meetings._language: auto (detect per recording), da or en

_dashboard_url: Optional: your dashboard address, e.g. https://<mac>.<tailnet>.ts.net/axella – Trips puts a link back to the trip in the calendar events it adds.
